limitations: Six functional ties across three arithmetic fixtures and two repeats do not establish general functional advantage, reliability or issue closure.
Separately versioned fix validation against v1, not isolated source ablation: user prompts/criteria/settings are equal, while full model messages and effective source defaults changed.
The pricing fixture is a separate comparison and does not satisfy the canonical recovery corpus failed-then-successful python_exec criterion.
Timing includes setup and joined cleanup on a warm shared endpoint; mixed pairwise times and zero-call controls do not establish a speedup.
The server is borrowed and not exclusively reserved. Its model alias/process/file-stat binding is not a fresh GGUF digest or proof of loaded tensors.
Worker process samples exclude server/model/GPU memory and may miss short-lived/unobserved reparented children; they are not continuous peaks, total-memory or 16 GB qualification.
Hosted API spend is zero for the recorded local route; hardware/electricity cost is unmeasured and the runtime pricing catalog remains unknown.
Zero-request repair controls retain null raw token usage and false all-dispatched-usage aggregate flags: no provider response exists, so usage is not applicable rather than a missing charged request.
The retained qualification_pass flag means harness/oracle acceptance only, not release, native-platform, human accessibility or general task verification.
Publication was read-only apart from the new report/archive; no experiment, test, endpoint call or model request was rerun.
